ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 16
   D. 0

2. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 56

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

5. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 7

7. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 9

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 122

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

11. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 41
   D. 13

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 8
3. Product = 64
Final Answer: 64
